The exact condition-number frontier resolves when a natural theoretical radius is nevertheless an objective descent step; beyond it, an explicit two-dimensional counterexample and a universal sharp fivefold inflation show the boundary is not cosmetic. This informs radius safety and metric choice without asserting a general smooth-nonlinear theorem.
